entities.name: Albiuto
entities.description: A floating settlement on Albiuto Lake in the mountains of Zhalfir.

entities.name: Vuel
entities.description: Stole the Legacy artifacts from Gerrard and fled to Albiuto.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Vuel's step-brother, robbed of the Legacy artifacts.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: Whose meddling caused Vuel to fail his rite of passage.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Followed Vuel to Albiuto and was deactivated.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Collected Karn and the Touchstone as part of her quest.

entities.name: Touchstone
entities.description: Artifact Vuel used to deactivate Karn.

entities.name: Sidar Kondo
entities.description: Whose village lies eight leagues away.

events.summary: In 4193 AR Vuel fails his rite of passage, steals Gerrard's Legacy artifacts and sells some at Albiuto.
events.quote: Vuel stole the Legacy artifacts from his step-brother Gerrard Capashen and brought them to Albiuto

events.summary: Karn confronts Vuel, who uses the Touchstone to freeze Karn as a statue for 11 years.
events.quote: Vuel used the Touchstone to deactivate Karn

events.summary: Sisay collects Karn and the Touchstone.
events.quote: until Sisay collected him and the Touchstone as part of her quest

events.summary: When Teferi phases Zhalfir out, Albiuto goes with it, later returning.
events.quote: When Teferi phased Zhalfir out , Albiuto went with it

relations.quote: Vuel used the Touchstone to deactivate Karn
Albiuto now exists as part of the plane of Zhalfir.
